note: Polk County MO has no public county zoning layer; zoning for Bolivar (largest city) is published via the City's Zoning Layer Map on the integritygis host (services3.integritygis.com, Polk_Assessor_Data_Integrity 'Bolivar Zoning' layer 50 and Bolivar_City_Data layer 7). Every such MapServer returns 'Token Required', so the zoning districts are not publicly queryable. No other Polk County city zoning service was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online or web search.
